content: In practice, for the reconstruction term can be based on the mean squared error (MSE) between the true target segment and the predicted target segment. For the second term in Eq DISPLAY_FORM8, samples for $p(z)$ are obtained from Gaussian distribution with zero mean and a variance of one ($p(z) \sim \mathcal {N} (0,1)$).
